rules.title: Your rules
rules.description: A rule always sends similar transactions to the same category. It beats the dictionary and Pluggy, and loses only to a correction you made.

empty.title: No rules yet
empty.description: When you correct a transaction and tick "always", the rule shows up here.

deleteRule.title: Delete the rule {{label}}?
deleteRule.description: Transactions this rule categorized go back to automatic categorization (dictionary, Pluggy or uncategorized). The ones you corrected by hand do not change.

newRule.title: New rule
newRule.patternHint: Capital letters, accents and date numbers make no difference.
newRule.applyToPast: Also apply to the transactions that already exist

errors.patternInvalid: This text is not valid as a rule. Use letters or numbers.
errors.limitReached: You reached the limit of 500 rules.

preview.loading: Counting how many transactions the rule affects
preview.result_one: The text becomes “{{pattern}}” and matches {{count}} transaction
preview.result_other: The text becomes “{{pattern}}” and matches {{count}} transactions
preview.result_zero: The text becomes “{{pattern}}” and matches no transactions

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Default categories can be renamed. Your own can also change icon and be deleted.
categories.transferNote: They count as neither spending nor income
categories.deleteLocked: Default categories cannot be deleted; you can rename them

errors.nameTaken: A category with this name already exists.
errors.limitReached: You reached the limit of 50 categories of your own.

deleteCategory.title: Delete the category {{name}}?
deleteCategory.rulesWarning: Rules that point to this category will be deleted.

errors.flexibilityNotApplicable: Income has no fixed or flexible

toasts.ruleCreatedFuture: Rule created. It applies to the next transactions.
toasts.ruleDeleted_one: Rule deleted: {{count}} transaction went back to automatic categorization
toasts.ruleDeleted_other: Rule deleted: {{count}} transactions went back to automatic categorization

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.description: You have changes that were not saved yet. If you leave now, they will be lost.

footer.dictionary: Vera's merchant dictionary is not edited here: it changes through a pull request in the repository.
